obligations.scope_review: Reviewed the LeasePool and SourceAdmission trace bounds, arbitrary-prefix held-slot and out-of-range refusal, and receipt absence. These quantify over arbitrary finite pools or prefixes. The corpus has no audited general bridge from total lease availability zero to absence of a selected token; slot-local refusal is not total-capacity refusal. This exact proof gap belongs to R03.

witnesses.name: heldReservationDenied
witnesses.statement:
(generation : Count) ->
    Equal CompletionToken (reservationToken (tryReserve (heldLease generation))) noOwnedLease
witnesses.establishes: A held lease produces no owned reservation token for every generation.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Local denial alone does not state that zero total availability implies every indexed admission is refused.

witnesses.name: pendingOccupancyTraceBound
witnesses.statement:
(trace : PoolTrace) -> (pool : LeasePool) ->
    AtMost (leaseOccupancy (runPool trace pool)) (leaseCapacity pool)
witnesses.establishes: Every finite PoolTrace preserves occupancy at most the initial LeasePool capacity.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: PoolTrace contains reserveAt and completeAt; pre-validation queues and established resources are separate.

witnesses.name: pendingConservationTrace
witnesses.statement:
(trace : PoolTrace) -> (pool : LeasePool) ->
    Equal Count (add (leaseOccupancy (runPool trace pool)) (leaseAvailability (runPool trace pool)))
      (leaseCapacity pool)
witnesses.establishes: Occupancy plus availability equals initial capacity after every finite PoolTrace.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Conservation does not state the saturated indexed admission decision.

witnesses.name: sourceAdmissionTracePendingBound
witnesses.statement:
(trace : SourceAdmissionTrace) -> (quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) ->
    (current : SourceAdmission) -> AtMost (leaseOccupancy (admissionPool (runSourceAdmissions trace quota capacity current)))
      (leaseCapacity (admissionPool current))
witnesses.establishes: Every finite SourceAdmissionTrace preserves pending occupancy at most the initial pool capacity, including indexed admissions, completions, maintenance and trusted clock events.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: This is the initial LeasePool capacity, not the source-table capacity argument, an earlier queue limit or an established-resource limit.

witnesses.name: sourceAdmissionTracePoolCapacity
witnesses.statement:
(trace : SourceAdmissionTrace) -> (quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) ->
    (current : SourceAdmission) -> Equal Count
      (leaseCapacity (admissionPool (runSourceAdmissions trace quota capacity current))) (leaseCapacity (admissionPool current))
witnesses.establishes: Every finite SourceAdmissionTrace preserves the exact initial LeasePool capacity.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: A fixed structural capacity does not by itself prove refusal from exhausted availability.

witnesses.name: noLeaseAdmissionIsNoOp
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) -> (source : Reachability) ->
    (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) -> (index : Count) -> (current : SourceAdmission) ->
    Equal CompletionToken (availableLeaseToken index (admissionPool current)) noOwnedLease ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (sourceAdmissionStep quota capacity (sourceAdmissionAttempt source swarm key index) current) current
witnesses.establishes: An attempt with no selected available token preserves the whole SourceAdmission state.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
The selected availableLeaseToken equals noOwnedLease.
witnesses.limits: Token absence is a premise; the statement does not derive it from exhausted total capacity.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionHeldRefused
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) -> (source : Reachability) ->
    (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission
      (sourceAdmissionStep quota capacity (sourceAdmissionAttempt source swarm key (leasePrefixIndex prefix))
        (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: A held selected lease at any structural prefix index refuses admission and preserves the complete state.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The selected slot is held; other slots may still be free. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. Runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization remain external obligations.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionMissingRefused
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) -> (source : Reachability) ->
    (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (distance : Count) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission
      (sourceAdmissionStep quota capacity
        (sourceAdmissionAttempt source swarm key (add (leaseCapacity prefix) distance))
        (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix emptyLeasePool)))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix emptyLeasePool))
witnesses.establishes: Every selected index at or beyond an arbitrary finite pool refuses admission and preserves the complete state.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The selection is out of range, independently of the occupancy of existing slots. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. Runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization remain external obligations.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionHeldHasNoReceipt
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (source : Reachability) ->
    (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) ->
    Equal AdmissionReceipt
      (admissionAttemptReceipt quota (sourceAdmissionAttempt source swarm key (leasePrefixIndex prefix))
        (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest)))) noAdmissionReceipt
witnesses.establishes: Every held selected slot produces no admission receipt, independently of source permission and credits.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: This is held-slot receipt absence rather than a total-pool saturation implication. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. Runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization remain external obligations.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionMissingHasNoReceipt
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (source : Reachability) ->
    (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (distance : Count) ->
    Equal AdmissionReceipt
      (admissionAttemptReceipt quota (sourceAdmissionAttempt source swarm key (add (leaseCapacity prefix) distance))
        (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix emptyLeasePool))) noAdmissionReceipt
witnesses.establishes: Every selection at or beyond an arbitrary finite pool produces no admission receipt.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: This is out-of-range receipt absence rather than a total-pool saturation implication. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. Runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization remain external obligations.

criteria.rationale: The general indexed held/missing-slot statements and token-absence implication establish complete-state refusal and no receipt. No audited statement derives token absence for every index from exhausted total pool availability.
criteria.remaining: R03: prove for every finite LeasePool and Count index that zero leaseAvailability implies availableLeaseToken is noOwnedLease, then compose with the general admission no-op and receipt-absence witnesses.

criteria.rationale: PoolTrace bound and conservation are complemented by the bound and exact capacity preservation for every finite SourceAdmissionTrace, which includes indexed admission, lifecycle and maintenance branches.

obligations.scope_review: Reviewed general whole-state unowned completion and arbitrary-prefix admission, receipt index/generation ownership and complete-state terminal release, as well as free-slot, repeated, mismatched and arbitrarily old-generation indexed callbacks. Prefix and suffix preservation supplies unrelated-slot protection. Owned release restores the pending occupancy baseline for all five PendingEnd constructors; source debt and spent credits stay consumed. Both sealed criteria are witnessed under atomic transitions, internal receipt authority, stable indexes and nonwrapping generations. External obligation E013 owns the runtime refinement of these premises, including callback authority.

witnesses.name: unownedCompletionNoRefund
witnesses.statement:
(reason : PendingEnd) -> (lease : Lease) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion noOwnedLease reason lease) lease
witnesses.establishes: An unowned completion is a no-op for every terminal reason and lease.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

witnesses.name: repeatedTerminalReasonsIdempotent
witnesses.statement:
(token : CompletionToken) ->
    (first : PendingEnd) -> (second : PendingEnd) -> (lease : Lease) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion token second (pendingCompletion token first lease))
      (pendingCompletion token first lease)
witnesses.establishes: A second terminal reason with the same token does not release again, for every token and lease.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

witnesses.name: arbitrarilyOldGenerationPreserved
witnesses.statement:
(generation : Count) -> (gap : Count) ->
    Equal Lease (releaseOwned generation (heldLease (next (add generation gap))))
      (heldLease (next (add generation gap)))
witnesses.establishes: An old generation cannot release a held successor generation separated by any finite gap.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The generation has the stated successor-plus-gap form; arbitrary slot-index and generation receipt validity still needs review.

witnesses.name: everyTerminalReasonReleases
witnesses.statement:
(generation : Count) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal Lease (pendingCompletion (ownedGeneration generation) reason (heldLease generation))
      (freeLease (next generation))
witnesses.establishes: A matching owned generation releases for failure, establishment, hook refusal, timeout and cancellation.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal callback tokens and nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Single lease terms; no theorem here relates arbitrary indexed receipts to whole-pool baseline restoration.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionChargesAndReserves
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (capacity : Count) -> (swarm : SwarmClass) ->
    (key : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) ->
    Equal Flag (sourceTableChargeAllowed validated quota key table) on ->
    Equal SourceAdmission
      (sourceAdmissionStep quota capacity (sourceAdmissionAttempt validated swarm key (leasePrefixIndex prefix))
        (sourceAdmission table (next credits) (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease generation) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission (restrictSource quota key (sourceChargeEvent validated) table) credits
        (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: A permitted validated admission with positive credits changes only the selected free lease to held, charges the canonical source and consumes one shared credit.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
sourceTableChargeAllowed validated quota key table equals on; credits have the form next credits; the selected lease is free.
witnesses.limits: The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionOwnsReceipt
witnesses.statement:
(quota : Count) -> (swarm : SwarmClass) -> (key : Count) ->
    (table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) -> (prefix : LeasePool) ->
    (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) ->
    Equal Flag (sourceTableChargeAllowed validated quota key table) on ->
    Equal AdmissionReceipt
      (admissionAttemptReceipt quota (sourceAdmissionAttempt validated swarm key (leasePrefixIndex prefix))
        (sourceAdmission table (next credits) (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease generation) rest))))
      (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) generation)
witnesses.establishes: The same eligible admission returns a receipt containing the exact structural prefix index and selected generation.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
sourceTableChargeAllowed validated quota key table equals on; credits have the form next credits; the selected lease is free.
witnesses.limits: The receipt is produced from the pre-admission state. Receipt authority and atomic pairing with the state update are modeled premises. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceCompletionActsOnSelectedLease
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (lease : Lease) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (token : Count) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) token) reason
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell lease rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits
        (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (pendingCompletion (ownedGeneration token) reason lease) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: Every modeled terminal reason applies pendingCompletion to the selected lease while preserving the source table, shared credits and every prefix/suffix lease.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: A pendingAdmissionReceipt supplies its index and generation; this statement does not cover noAdmissionReceipt. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionCompletionReleases
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) generation) reason
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease (next generation)) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: Every PendingEnd releases the matching held generation to the next free generation, preserving the complete prefix/suffix, source table and credit balance.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
The internal receipt identifies the selected currently held generation.
witnesses.limits: The pending occupancy returns to its corresponding pre-reservation baseline because free generations contribute zero occupancy. The whole pre-admission state is not restored: source debt and spent credits stay consumed. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionFreeCompletionIsNoOp
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (token : Count) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) token) reason
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease generation) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease generation) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: A callback targeting a free selected lease preserves the complete admission state for any token and terminal reason.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The selected lease must be free. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionDuplicateCompletion
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (first : PendingEnd) -> (second : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission
      (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) generation) second
        (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) generation) first
          (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest)))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (freeLease (next generation)) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: Any two terminal reasons for the same indexed owned receipt have exactly the single-release state.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
The selected lease is held by the matching generation before the first callback.
witnesses.limits: No intervening re-reservation is modeled in this two-callback statement; stale-reuse cases have separate general witnesses. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionMismatchedCompletionPreserves
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (token : Count) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal Flag (sameCount token generation) off ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) token) reason
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease generation) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: Any indexed callback whose token differs from the held selected generation preserves the complete state.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
sameCount token generation equals off.
witnesses.limits: The mismatch premise is explicit; index authorization remains a runtime premise. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: indexedSourceAdmissionStaleCompletionPreserves
witnesses.statement:
(table : SourceTable) -> (credits : Count) ->
    (prefix : LeasePool) -> (generation : Count) -> (gap : Count) -> (rest : LeasePool) -> (reason : PendingEnd) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission (pendingAdmissionReceipt (leasePrefixIndex prefix) generation) reason
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease (next (add generation gap))) rest))))
      (sourceAdmission table credits (appendLeasePool prefix (leaseCell (heldLease (next (add generation gap))) rest)))
witnesses.establishes: An indexed receipt preserves every later held generation next (add generation gap), for arbitrary gap and terminal reason.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: Count generations do not wrap; forged matching receipts are outside the internal-callback model. The prefix and suffix are arbitrary finite LeasePools, including other held leases. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority, index stability and serialization.

witnesses.name: unownedAdmissionCompletionIsNoOp
witnesses.statement:
(reason : PendingEnd) -> (current : SourceAdmission) ->
    Equal SourceAdmission (finishSourceAdmission noAdmissionReceipt reason current) current
witnesses.establishes: Every noAdmissionReceipt completion preserves the whole SourceAdmission state for every terminal reason.
premises: Atomic modeled transitions; internal index-bound receipts; nonwrapping Count generations.
witnesses.limits: The callback has no receipt; forged matching receipts are excluded by internal receipt authority. External obligation E013 owns runtime receipt authority. The statement preserves arbitrary pools, including unrelated held leases.

criteria.rationale: The general whole-admission unowned equality and indexed full-state equalities cover unrelated live slots, free slots, duplicate callbacks and all mismatched generations, including arbitrarily old receipts. Every statement quantifies over arbitrary modeled state or prefix/suffix and terminal reasons; no finite-example credit is needed.

The arbitrary-prefix admission equality and exact receipt equality identify the sole reserved lease. The release equality quantifies over every PendingEnd and preserves all other leases. Since leaseOccupancy ignores a free lease generation, changing that selected held lease to free restores exactly the occupancy of the corresponding pre-reservation pool; source debt and shared credit charges remain consumed.

obligations.scope_review: Audited fixed source-table width under arbitrary SourceSystemTrace and protected-cell eviction. Multiple-prefix attribution, restart/epoch lifetime rules and the full shared T4b/T8 security-state bridge remain unaudited.

witnesses.name: sourceSystemTraceSlotBound
witnesses.statement:
(events : SourceSystemTrace) -> (capacity : Count) -> (table : SourceTable) ->
    AtMost (sourceTableSize (runSourceSystem events capacity table)) (sourceTableWidth table)
witnesses.establishes: Resident source-table size never exceeds its initial fixed width under every finite SourceSystemTrace.
premises: SourceTable has a fixed finite slot width; transitions are the modeled registration, eviction and enforcement events.
witnesses.limits: Count keys do not themselves establish IPv4/IPv6 prefix attribution or restart retention.

witnesses.name: sourceCellEvictionPreservesProtection
witnesses.statement:
(cell : SourceCell) ->
    Equal SourceCell (protectedSourceCell (evictSourceCell cell)) (protectedSourceCell cell)
witnesses.establishes: The protected projection of every SourceCell is unchanged by evictSourceCell.
premises: Protected debt and ban constructors are preserved; only clear entries can be evicted.
witnesses.limits: Single-cell eviction is not a general restart, re-registration or multi-prefix lifetime theorem.

criteria.rationale: The statement bounds every modeled trace and initial table by that table fixed finite width.
Eviction preserves local protected state; the larger lifecycle requirement has not been audited.
criteria.remaining: Audit protected debt/ban persistence across arbitrary re-registration, shared source/prefix accounting and restart/epoch transitions.

obligations.scope_review: Audited the general aggregate burst-plus-trusted-ticks envelope and a closed two-swarm example. Distinct source/prefix time envelopes, IPv4/IPv6 attribution, fresh identities and trusted traffic remain unaudited; the example does not establish those general scopes.

witnesses.name: sourceAdmissionBurstRateEnvelope
witnesses.statement:
(trace : TimedSourceAdmissionTrace) -> (quota : Count) ->
    (capacity : Count) -> (burst : Count) -> (rate : Count) -> (current : SourceAdmission) ->
    AtMost (admissionCredits current) burst ->
    AtMost (sourceAdmissionStarts (timedSourceAdmissions trace rate) quota capacity current)
      (add burst (multiply (sourceAdmissionTrustedTicks trace) rate))
witnesses.establishes: Aggregate successful starts over every TimedSourceAdmissionTrace are at most burst plus trusted ticks times rate.
premises: Explicit proof argument: AtMost (admissionCredits current) burst.
Only authoritative trusted tick events issue credits; the modeled admission decisions enforce their defined checks.
witnesses.limits: The conclusion counts aggregate starts; it does not state a separate time envelope for every source or IPv4/IPv6 prefix.

witnesses.name: admissionRateCountsBothSwarms
witnesses.statement:
Equal Count
    (sourceAdmissionStarts (timedSourceAdmissions admissionRateReuseTrace (next zero))
      (next zero) (next zero) admissionExampleReady) (next (next zero))
witnesses.establishes: The fixed admissionRateReuseTrace counts two successful starts, one from each swarm.
premises: The exact closed admissionRateReuseTrace, admissionExampleReady state and unit quota/capacity/rate are fixed.
witnesses.limits: No arbitrary state, trace, prefix or swarm-allocation quantifier occurs in this statement.

criteria.rationale: The aggregate envelope is general; the two-swarm reuse result is only a finite example.
criteria.remaining: Audit distinct source/prefix and aggregate burst-plus-rate envelopes across all swarms, trusted traffic and fresh identities.

criteria.rationale: The exact initial-credit premise and trusted-tick aggregate scope are retained without crediting the closed example as general.
criteria.remaining: Audit IPv4/IPv6 prefix attribution, unvalidated victim-address rejection and the relevant conditional/failure branches for the complete rate requirement.
